blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —The Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan) coalition on Wednesday blasted President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. over his remarks on the continued depreciation of the Philippine peso. The group accused the president and his administration of lack of plans in handling this worsening crisis. Bayan’s view came after Marcos earlier told the public not to panic as the government is already doing everything it can to keep the value of peso from going down further.
